environment.description: Bare-metal Debian 12 host running the Actix-web binary compiled in release mode with RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=3'. No MAC framework enabled (AppArmor is installed but in complain-only mode globally). Process runs as service user 'apprunner' with read access to /etc/shadow, /proc/self/maps, and arbitrary filesystem paths. No seccomp filter applied. Kernel has no ASLR for position-dependent executables. The null pointer dereference causes a SIGSEGV that can be weaponized via /proc/self/maps information disclosure through the path traversal (canonicalize race) before the crash.
